milestones.title: Smoother saves for persistent worlds
milestones.summary: Save changed world and player state in smaller batches while gameplay continues, with safe recovery after interruptions.
milestones.availability_note: In development. Full recovery and live-server availability are not yet verified.

milestones.title: Extraction survival
milestones.summary: Explore dangerous areas, collect loot and return to a persistent safehouse. Extraction and survival shape what you keep between runs.
milestones.availability_note: Not released. Development changes do not yet establish a playable public release.

milestones.availability_note: An idea for future investigation; implementation has not started.
